reader_summary.headline: On today's Manager Meeting, Andy Golden interviews Allan Jean-Baptiste and Marco DeMeireles of Ansa Capital.
reader_summary.overview: On today's Manager Meeting, Andy Golden interviews Allan Jean-Baptiste and Marco DeMeireles of Ansa Capital. Andy is President of PRINCO where he has overseen the management of Princeton University's endowment since 1995. Alongside his long successful tenure, he is a master with wordplay and the use of the pun.

key_points.text: Allan and Marco are the Co-Founders and General Partners of Ansa Capital.
Their conversation covers Ansa's long-term perspective, approach to partnerships, risk management, team dynamics, and operating model.
Allan and Marco also share their perspective on current market conditions, the opportunity set, and raising their first fund.
